cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You said you'd take it from here. Here are the unanswered wedding invitations. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant I'd answer the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. These people need an answer before reaching it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me explain where your generous offer ended.

mechanism: A runs wedding replies by treating B earlier door offer as an assignment, then shrinking the handoff enough to retain help.
confusable: A new favour differs from repeatedly treating a specific past offer as already covering the disputed work.
comparison: The fete alternative recasts a word-painting offer as organising the advertised event rather than correspondence.
seedUse: Invitation seed supplies the answer-the-door double meaning; S02 changes the demanded work when B refuses the larger responsibility.
